subject: Re: Saturday gathering
text: I hope your week is going gently. I am still thinking about your note. You mentioned a favor that might help the neighborhood group. The instruction was unclear, and I do not want to guess. If you meant an invitation, I would be glad to come. I can arrive late afternoon. I can stay a short time. I will bring a chair. I do not need much. I only want to be useful. If the instruction meant something else, please say so. I can still help another way. Let me know what suits you. I will wait for your reply. I appreciate your honesty. Thank you kindly. Take care.
